newsitem.title: USA: Donnelly Corp appoints three executives.
newsitem.headline: Donnelly Corp appoints three executives.

text.p: Donnelly Corp said Tuesday it appointed two vice presidents and one executive director, all newly created positions.

The company named Jeffrey Wincel to the post of vice president of materials for its North American operation, Daniel Joseph as vice president of the Ford Business Unit and Kenneth Schofield to the post of executive director of advanced engineering for the company's global operations.
Donnelly is an international automotive glass supplier.
Its stock was unchanged Tuesday afternoon at 23-3/4.
